selection: First 128 original-order source indices eligible under all three target tokenizers; LCC cap 3072, MultiNews cap 3584. Complete saved prompts are copied unchanged. No truncation, duplication, shuffle, reference-based or outcome-based selection.

cpu_execution.cuda_visible_devices: set empty by script before Transformers import

provenance.scan_overlap_boundary: The source CPU scan ran while the static6 campaign was in progress. Its recorded single-CPU affinity and nice19 do not establish zero CPU interference; the original scan time window is preserved, without subtracting any inferred cost.

boundaries: The source CPU scan ran while the static6 campaign was in progress. Its recorded single-CPU affinity and nice19 do not establish zero CPU interference; the original scan time window is preserved, without subtracting any inferred cost.
Each target's two draft sources must reuse its same workload file and split.
Equal source identity across targets preserves full task/context, not token counts or chat/base-model behavior equivalence.
References are retained unchanged and checked for source identity; no reference text controls eligibility or selection.
4096 prompt/output/G7 context legality does not establish GPU KV capacity, fixed actual concurrency, acceptance or performance.
